scope: Central surviving Kasugayama mountain castle earthworks, including the summit, southwest keep and well terraces, second enclosure and eastern spur approach.

originalReview.notes: The exact published summit enclosure photo, with stone stele, roofed wooden history board, smaller markers, pines and earthen floor.

quallaSearch.notes: Started with Soica2001’s exact creator-released original from the Qualla story. The alternate uploads are illustrations or old map photographs, with differing source provenance. These were excluded from the contemporary exterior model.
